chunks: Safwan ibn Mihran al-Jammal narrated from al-Sadiq Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad عليه السلام, who said:
He was traveling, and I was with him in al-Qadisiyyah until he came upon al-Najaf, then he said:

“It is the mountain to which the son of my grandfather Nuh عليه السلام sought refuge, when he said: ‘I will take refuge on a mountain that will protect me from the water.’ Then Allah, Mighty and Exalted, revealed to it: ‘O mountain, can anyone seek refuge from Me in you?’ So it sank into the earth and was broken apart toward al-Sham.”

Then he عليه السلام said, “Turn us aside.” He said: So I turned with him, and he continued traveling until he came to al-Ghariyy. He stood at the grave and conveyed peace from Adam, upon each Prophet one by one عليهم السلام, and I conveyed peace with him until the peace reached the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. Then he fell upon the grave, greeted it with peace, and his sobbing grew loud.

Then he stood and performed four rakʿahs of salat, and in another report, six rakʿahs, and I prayed with him. I said to him, “O son of the Messenger of Allah, what is this grave?” He said, “This grave is the grave of my grandfather ʿAli ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام.”

key_terms.النَّجَفِ: al-Najaf, the region overlooking the sacred grave site
key_terms.الْغَرِيَّ: al-Ghariyy, the location of the grave visited in the report
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave at which the Imam stood and prayed
key_terms.رَكَعَاتٍ: units of salat performed at the site
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: Imam ʿAli ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام, identified as the one buried there
key_terms.نُوحٍ: Nuh (Noah) عليه السلام, referenced through the flood narrative

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام identify the grave of Imam ʿAli ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام in al-Najaf?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام identifying the sacred site at al-Najaf and linking it to the story of Nuh عليه السلام and the futility of seeking refuge from Allah outside His will. It then describes the Imam’s visitation, salutation of the Prophets and the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, prayer at the grave, and his declaration that it is the grave of أمير المؤمنين ʿAli ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام.
